Investment Consultant for Climate-Smart Agriculture Investments
Cote d'Ivoire
INTRODUCTION TO GGGI

The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) is a treaty-based international, inter-governmental organization dedicated to supporting and promoting strong, inclusive and sustainable economic growth in developing countries and emerging economies. To learn more please visit about GGGI web page.
Application Deadline: Shown in the bottom of the page. All applications must be submitted by 10:00 PM (KST) on the closing date.

Consultancy Type: Daily Rate

Contract Duration: /01/02/2027 ~ 29/03/2028
Application Deadline: 26/12/2026
Project Background

The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI), through the Korea Green New Deal Trust Fund (KGNDTF)-supported Sustainable Agriculture for Food and Energy (SAFE) Initiative, is supporting the development of climate-smart agriculture (CSA) value chains across Africa. The initiative seeks to increase agricultural productivity, reduce post-harvest losses, strengthen value addition, and mobilize private investment into resilient agricultural infrastructure, including solar irrigation, storage, processing, and logistics systems.

Under Component 3, GGGI's Africa Regional Office is responsible for regional coordination, knowledge generation, investment readiness assessments, and the development of a broader regional pipeline of investment opportunities in four additional countries including Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda and Cote d’Ivoire. Building on anchor investments in Rwanda and Senegal, the initiative aims to contribute to the development of approximately USD 500 millions of bankable climate-smart agriculture investments across Africa.

To support implementation of this component, GGGI seeks to engage a qualified consulting firm to undertake regional knowledge development, investment readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement, and pipeline development activities.
Objective of the Assignment

The Consultant will serve as an Investment Consultant to support Component 3 of the SAFE Initiative project focusing on climate smart agriculture investment project pipeline development across Cote d’Ivoire, Ethiopia, Kenya and Uganda.

The objective of the assignment is to support the development of a regional pipeline of investment-ready CSA projects in targeted countries through research, financial and investment analysis, technical quality assurance, investor engagement, and Korean partnership development support.

The Consultant will ensure that outputs developed by the consulting firm meet GGGI quality standards and contribute to the overall objective of mobilizing climate-smart agriculture investments across Africa.
Scope of Work

The Consultant will work closely with the SAFE project team under the supervision of the Regional Investment Lead and the SAFE project coordinator. He or She will also work with GGGI targeted country teams and selected external stakeholders.
Output 1: Project Implementation Support

Support the implementation and reporting of the SAFE project Component 3 and related investment activities under the leadership of the Regional Investment Lead Africa and the SAFE Initiative project Coordinator.
Provide support for research, data collection activities related to the project, including data processing, analysis and reports writing.
Support project coordinator to report investment activities consistency across regional and country-level activities.
Contribute to the Component 3 investment activities reporting and quality assurance under the supervision of the Regional Investment Lead Africa.
Support in project communication investment related activities and knowledge products development and dissemination.
Output 2: Regional investment support and pipeline development

Support identification, screening and prioritization of climate-smart agriculture opportunities across GGGI member countries including Uganda, Kenya, Ethiopia and Côte d'Ivoire. This will lead to the development of a Regional Investment SAFE projects pipeline contributing towards the SAFE investment targets.

Provide input to selected project structuring to enhance bankability and support in matching with targeted priority investors. The consultant will refine project concepts in targeted countries in alignment with both countries' priorities, SAFE investment selection criteria and investors criteria.

Assist in investor engagement work including mapping, outreach, and negotiations for Senegal and Rwanda projects under SAFE Initiative. The consultant will support engagement with DFIs, impact investors, agribusiness funds, commercial investors, and Korean investment institutions.
Identify opportunities for blended finance and PPP structures with identified key DFI, private sector actor both at the country, regional and international levels.
Contribute to investment readiness assessment of targeted countries and lessons learned knowledge products
Output 3: Korean partnership and investor engagement
Working with GGGI Korean partnership staff to identify Korean technology providers relevant to climate-smart agriculture value chains in targeted countries in Africa.
Support engagement with Korean private-sector partners interested in selected projects.
Facilitate partnership discussions between Korean stakeholders and project developers through the development of projects investment profiles and pitch materials.
Research on technology transfer opportunities to be presented to local project sponsors partners

Support organization of investor engagement events, business matchmaking activities and knowledge sharing events as well as GGGI participation to key investments forum including Africa Food Systems Forum, Africa Climate Summit, Africa-Korea Business Forums.
